title: Alaska UFO Mystery as Giant Jellyfish-Like Object With 'Moving Tentacles' Appears Near US F-22 Military Base
description: A woman in Anchorage, Alaska, said she photographed a dark, jellyfish-shaped object hovering for about three minutes before it disappeared near the direction of a US military base.

title: Jellyfish UFO Filmed Hovering Near Anchorage Base Before Vanishing, Witness Says
description: Sara Jane Osborn says she photographed and filmed a dark, jellyfish-shaped object hovering above Anchorage trees, though a kite, drone or other conventional explanation remains possible.

title: Giant Jellyfish-Shaped UFO Spotted Near US Military Base Before Vanishing Without a Trace
description: A bizarre, tentacled object resembling a giant jellyfish was spotted hovering above a wooded area near a US military installation in Alaska before disappearing after approximately three minutes. Sara Jane Osborn, who witnessed the incident alongside her husband, Pete, said she was taking photographs of a rainbow in Anchorage when she noticed the unidentified object […]

title: Giant UFO with dangling tentacles hovers near US military base before vanishing: 'Only God and the government know what it is'
description: A mysterious object was spotted soaring over a US military base. Eyewitnesses said it had dangling appendages and hovered from side to side.

title: '3 times faster than an F-22': Trump reveals Air Force pilots' bizarre UFO encounter
description: US President Donald Trump addressed questions about the UFO files, saying he was briefed on several unusual sightings reported by Air Force pilots during meetings held throughout both of his terms in office. Trump appeared on CBS’s “60 Minutes” Sunday, where he discussed the topic among several others. “They’re great, great pilots. They’re the real deal. And they’ve told me things that are very strange. They said that in certain cases. They said yes, there’s something going on out there. Because they’re flying an F-22, which is the best there is, the fastest, the best plane that anyone’s ever seen. And something goes by them at three times their speed, and it’s round. It’s not aerodynamic; it’s round.”
